bindings.agreement_handler: Reuse existing approved agreement flow; no new endpoint is specified by this design.

rules: The scope and payment plan must be accessible before assent.
Do not submit on behalf of the user or preselect agreement.
Validate name and checkbox; return visible field errors without clearing input.
Reuse current server-side authorisation, agreement versioning and audit record behaviour.
A button click, local checkbox or success animation must not itself establish server-side agreement completion.
Do not charge, send contract requests, mark payments received or enable live automation as a new side effect of this redesign.

sections.layout: Thin rule; Sorted wordmark left and privacy/contact text right.

copy.description: Private onboarding workspace for Derma Botanica.

interaction_states.accordions: Real disclosure buttons with aria-expanded, visible focus and inline expanded content. No navigation required.

signing.submitting: Disable repeated submit; label Signing…; preserve values.
signing.success: Use the existing server-confirmed success state and next-step message.
signing.failure: Show a readable retry message; do not report success.

interaction_states.links: Use existing real destinations. Unresolved URLs must be configured before release; do not ship invented # or demo destinations as live actions.

breakpoints.behaviour: Desktop split hero, three stage columns, three payment columns and two-column content/form.
Reduce gutter to 32px; permit hero to stack; retain metric/payment columns only while readable.

20px gutter, 36px hero heading, 27px section heading, 42px metrics. Stack hero, journey, payment information, outcomes, scope, metrics and form. Remove vertical column rules in favour of horizontal rules.

rules: Never shrink explanatory body text just to retain desktop columns.
Keep all commercial terms and disclaimers visible.
Buttons and checkboxes have at least 44px touch targets.
Allow natural page height; no horizontal overflow.

requirements: Semantic header, main, sections and footer.
One h1 and a consistent heading ladder.
Check contrast in build, especially lime surfaces and muted dark-panel text.
Visible keyboard focus on controls and links.
Persistent form labels and programmatically associated error text.
Stage state communicated by text as well as colour.
Respect reduced motion and focus when using anchor scrolling.

content_integrity.prototype: Demonstration of flow, not proof of operational integrations or security.
content_integrity.commercial_changes: Do not alter price, payment split, tax treatment or signed scope through design implementation.
content_integrity.privacy: Do not infer that a page labelled private has working access control. Retain or implement agreed protection before live release.

acceptance_criteria: No photographic or illustrative assets appear.
Current demo-review stage and primary actions are immediately clear.
£6,000 total, £600 start and £5,400 handover remain consistent everywhere.
The three broad stages disclose the original seven-stage journey without changing underlying state.
Practical outcomes and remaining implementation scope are distinct.
Potential-value assumptions are labelled and alternative-build figures are not counted as recurring savings.
No £31,932 combined value or 19% claim remains in this selected design.
Signing retains existing approved behaviour without new payment or activation side effects.
Desktop and mobile renders are checked for spacing, readability, focus and overflow.
